name: an exported-signature edit on staging produces an interface push to the editing agent (SPEC-P-002)
command: 1. Under a held 'mutation probe' file lock on packages/operator-core/lib/code-intelligence/interface-eligibility.ts, make an exported-signature edit (add an optional field to the input of the exported function captureInterfaceEligibility) through tools:invoke { name:'capability:edit', args:{ file_path, old_string, new_string } } on POST http://127.0.0.1:3170/api/mcp?superuser=1&client=su-fc263bb4-f17b-422d-b2ad-e21ff0e1332f.

2. Build the PostToolUse hook body for that edit and run the hook's own collectInterfaceEdits(body) from apps/operator/scripts/hooks/inject/core.mjs, which fills toolCalls[].interfaceEdits (changes ['signature captureInterfaceEligibility'], base = the pre-edit blob).
3. POST that body to http://127.0.0.1:3170/api/agent-mcp/mid-turn-context (the hook's endpoint) and read the returned additional context.
4. Revert the edit (old_string/new_string swapped) and confirm git status --porcelain is empty for the file; release the lock.

5. Read the ledger row: SELECT * FROM harness_shared.code_intel_pushes WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND leg='interface' AND owner_id='su-fc263bb4-f17b-422d-b2ad-e21ff0e1332f' ORDER BY pushed_at DESC LIMIT 1
summary: The replayed exported-signature edit on :3170 (build 1699b8bed1) produced an interface push. The mid-turn-context response carried the interface note, and code_intel_pushes id 6702 was written with leg=interface, owner_id = the editing agent, subject naming the changed signature. The edit was reverted and the file left clean.

assertions.evidence: code_intel_pushes id 6702 has leg='interface' and pushed_at 16:04:39Z, inside the replay window 16:04:34-16:04:46Z.
owner_id of row 6702 is su-fc263bb4-f17b-422d-b2ad-e21ff0e1332f, the owner that made the edit.
After the revert, git status --porcelain was empty for interface-eligibility.ts.
